meta.title: A quantity not equal to the auction quantity is refused when fixed-quantity bidding is on
gaps: it depends on a company setting this run does not change — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug
the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.

plan.title: A quantity not equal to the auction quantity is refused when fixed-quantity bidding is on
